Container.Name: melomancer
Container.Overview: Discord music bot with a web panel for tabletop RPG sessions. Shared music library (upload files or fetch single videos with yt-dlp), private playlists grouped into sets and groups (per system, scenario or location), one-click playback, volume control, several users. The bot needs only a bot token; the panel runs on port 8080. First start creates the administrator from ADMIN_USERNAME and ADMIN_PASSWORD. / Bot muzyczny Discord z panelem webowym na sesje RPG: wspolna biblioteka, prywatne playlisty w zestawach, odpalanie jednym przyciskiem, regulacja glosnosci, wielu uzytkownikow.

Config.Name: Web panel port
Config.Description: Port of the web panel. Do not expose it directly to the internet; put it behind a Cloudflare Tunnel with Access or a VPN.

Config.Name: Data (database + music library)
Config.Description: Holds the SQLite database and the music library. On Unraid prefer a direct pool path (for example /mnt/nvme/appdata/melomancer) over /mnt/user, because SQLite behaves better on a real filesystem than on the FUSE user share.

Config.Name: Discord bot token
Config.Description: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal (Bot page - Reset Token). Without it the panel runs but the bot stays offline.

Config.Name: Admin username
Config.Description: Name of the first administrator. Used only on the first start, when the database is empty.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Password of the first administrator, at least 10 characters. Used only on the first start; change it later in the panel (account menu). If left empty a random password is generated and written once to the container log.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id that owns the files in /data. Unraid default: 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id that owns the files in /data. Unraid default: 100 (users).

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Time zone used in the logs.

Config.Name: Downloads enabled
Config.Description: true = users can add single videos by URL (yt-dlp downloads the audio once into the library). false = upload files only.

Config.Name: Downloads per day
Config.Description: Maximum number of downloads in 24 hours (0 = no limit). Keeps your IP address out of trouble with YouTube.

Config.Name: Pause between downloads (s)
Config.Description: Seconds to wait between two downloads.

Config.Name: Allowed download sites
Config.Description: Comma separated list of host names (sub-domains included) that may be downloaded from.

Config.Name: Max upload size (MB)
Config.Description: Largest single file that may be uploaded or downloaded. Cloudflare Tunnel itself limits one request to 100 MB on the Free and Pro plans.

Config.Name: Leave empty channel after (min)
Config.Description: The bot leaves a voice channel when no human has been in it for this many minutes (0 = never).

Config.Name: Default volume
Config.Description: Starting volume of the bot, 0.0 to 1.5 (1.0 = 100%).

Config.Name: Secure cookie
Config.Description: auto = the login cookie is marked Secure when the panel is opened over https (for example through the tunnel). true/false forces it.
